heading: EXT. FLOODED RICE TERRACE - FORWARD OBSERVATION POST - DAWN

units.text: EXT. FLOODED RICE TERRACE - FORWARD OBSERVATION POST - DAWN
Mist on green water.
A sandbagged dugout at the edge of a terrace wall.
SERGEANT AUGUSTIN MBEKI (30s, helmet, binoculars) lies on his belly scanning the far ridge.
Beside him, CORPORAL TEODOR BRANDVOLD (20s, radio on his back) chews a stalk of grass.
Nobody light a cigarette. I mean it.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Nobody answers.
The dugout holds only the two of them.
Mbeki lowers the binoculars.
Sarge, he's out there again.
units.name: BRANDVOLD

units.text: Who?
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: The farmer. The one with the buffalo.
units.name: BRANDVOLD

units.text: Mbeki raises the binoculars.
A man on the far terrace guides a water buffalo through the paddy, unhurried.
He's been told to clear out.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: He doesn't have anywhere to go, Sarge.
units.name: BRANDVOLD

units.text: Mbeki lowers the glasses.
He watches Brandvold for a long moment.
Brandvold keeps his eyes on the water.
Neither do we.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: What?
units.name: BRANDVOLD

units.text: Nothing. Get the radio. Tell HQ the farmer's working his field.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Brandvold unslings the radio.
He holds the handset a while before pressing the key.
Mbeki takes off his helmet, lays it on the sandbags, and watches the buffalo's slow progress across the shining paddy.
Echo Three, this is Echo Three-One. All quiet at the post.
units.name: BRANDVOLD

units.text: He lets go of the key.
Mbeki rests his chin on his folded arms.
All quiet.
units.name: MBEKI
